source.required: One complete OSM XML or Overpass JSON artifact with all referenced objects. No PBF importer, shoreline substitution or country fetch.
source.knownFailure: Two earlier small audit Overpass queries failed; no new probe or acquisition performed.
source.provenance: Record source URL, query/bbox, timestamp, object counts, missing-reference checks, bytes and SHA256 before generation.
source.dataOffer: Retain exact underlying OSM input and required modified database offer with provenance, separate from private code. No OSM data included now.

settings.benchmarkFlag: Not listed in retained v3.2.0 help. Do not pass --benchmark. Main must reconcile before lease; log timings/resources externally.
settings.groundLevelPolicy: 64 is proposed to match court ground. The accepted court transform stays immutable; a candidate needs its own separately accepted transform.

admission.prerequisite: Actual installed FORK adapter action proof after 11:10 gate, complete ready source, measured Desktop lease and no conflicting required work.
admission.sharedBudgetStarts: First authorized compact acquisition/probe/generation; NOT STARTED
rules: Unknown measured durations or capacity deny expansion.
64x64 proves compatibility only; no linear timing or country coverage forecast.
One World job: record PID/start, source/settings hashes, leased cache/output, exact generated child path, stop deadline and exit.
Never merge or append generated regions; place court last.
Save/stop/reopen before immutable transfer; never copy active worlds.
Reserve at least five minutes or longer measured conversion/reconciliation inside the original 20-minute budget.
One half-size retry only inside original budget with Main approval; never automatic.
On failure reconcile writer and retain fictional court.
